unsupported: Southern Woodcraft, LLC operates from Bluffton, South Carolina, where it produces custom hardwood cabinetry and millwork for residential clients.
Southern Woodcraft serves homeowners in the Bluffton area and surrounding Lowcountry region, providing tailored solutions for kitchen and bath remodels, custom storage, and architectural woodwork.
The company works directly with clients rather than through contractors, offering free quotes and collaborative design.
By focusing on one-on-one client relationships, the firm aims to align each project with the homeowner's style, budget, and timeline.
